$comment: Explanatory starting point, not a trusted or certified preset, for the optional <policy_dir>/claude/mcp.json. Review and adapt it before copying; the copy is user-owned. Create it before policy registration, chmod 600 yourself, and keep it beside settings.json outside every workspace. Enso validates but never creates, copies, chmods, rewrites, upgrades, or repairs the canonical source. Its presence turns MCP on for the policy and is hashed into policy_revision; delete the file deliberately to disable MCP.
$comment_secrets: Keep this file secret-free: ${VAR} references resolve from the launch environment. Name each variable in the policy's env_passthrough and deliver its value through ~/.enso/secrets/*.env. enso config check warns about credential-shaped literal values.
$comment_permissions: Under --permission-mode dontAsk, a server no permission rule references has every tool denied — pair each server with mcp__<server> or mcp__<server>__<tool> rules in settings.json. MCP servers are dialled by the provider process and bypass the sandbox's network allowlist, so list only servers whose entire tool surface is acceptable for the policy.
